XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on, with properly running vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0380 | GLOW PLUG | GLOW PLUGS | START-UP | STRUGGLE | DIFFICULT | IGNITION | STARTING | FLASHES | INTERMITTENT | MORNING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Glow plug

  • Fault: Difficulty starting when the engine is cold, with the glow plug warning light flashing briefly whilst starting the engine.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0380 (Pre-ignition glow plug 1 timing control - Malfunction)

  • Cause: Faulty glow plug

• Action: Check that the glow plug is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The vehicle is fitted with a single glow plug; it is located between the engine and the passenger compartment, on the driver’s side above the intake manifolds.
    In this case, the glow plug was found to be burnt out and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.4 hours.
